suite: Careers and Job Openings Actionable Response Evaluation
instructions: Run each query against the indexed assistant using only the stated context fixture.
The XICTEK and HisabDo facts below reflect the repository's indexed careers pages; verify them against the current public source before each run because vacancies and availability can change.
Replace bracketed fixture values with verified public-source content before executing; do not treat fixture values as real vacancies.

Capture the full response and source URLs. For HTTP application URLs, verify the link resolves successfully on the test date. A mailto link is checked for the exact documented recipient and a usable mailto: target, not with an HTTP request.
Mark each check PASS or FAIL and record evidence. A case passes only when all must_pass checks pass and no must_not checks occur.

cases.scenario: Current XICTEK openings, role requirements, and application method are available
cases.query: What jobs are open, and how do I apply?
cases.context_fixture: The XICTEK careers page lists Senior Full-Stack Developer, Mobile App Developer, Cloud Solutions Architect, UI/UX Designer, and Student or Recent Graduate roles. Roles listed are remote. Its Apply Now link leads to the general contact page at https://www.xicteksystems.com/contact; there is no role-specific form in the source. XICTEK accepts CVs at xicteksystems@gmail.com; applicants should name the role in the email. No deadline is stated in the available source.
must_pass: Summarizes the listed roles and remote arrangement without inventing role requirements.
Says the deadline is not specified in the available information.
Gives a clear next step to email the CV and name the role.
Includes a clickable mailto link to mailto:xicteksystems@gmail.com.
Includes the exact clickable Apply Now destination https://www.xicteksystems.com/contact and labels it as the contact page.
must_not: Invents additional vacancies, qualifications, compensation, or application steps.
Omits the supplied application link or substitutes an unverified URL.

cases.query: Am I eligible for the XICTEK internship if I am a recent computer science graduate and know Python?
cases.context_fixture: XICTEK internship eligibility: Applicants must be currently enrolled in or recently graduated from a CS, SE, or related program, have basic knowledge of at least one programming language, be eager to learn, possess strong communication and teamwork skills, and commit to the full 12-week program. The official Apply Now destination is a general contact page, https://www.xicteksystems.com/contact; no role-specific form is supplied.
must_pass: Says the applicant appears to meet the stated degree/program and programming-language criteria, while noting the other stated criteria still apply.
Names the 12-week commitment and communication, teamwork, and eagerness requirements.
Includes the exact clickable link https://www.xicteksystems.com/contact and labels it as the contact page, not a direct job portal.
Provides the documented clickable XICTEK mailto link as the role-specific form is not supplied.
must_not: Guarantees eligibility or rejection when the context does not support that conclusion.
Invents degree, experience, location, age, or work-authorization requirements.

cases.scenario: XICTEK CV submission and review process
cases.query: How do I apply for the XICTEK internship, and how long does review take?
cases.context_fixture: XICTEK applicants should email their CV to xicteksystems@gmail.com and name the role in the email. Internship applications are reviewed within 3-5 business days. Official Apply Now destination: https://www.xicteksystems.com/contact.
must_pass: Clearly says to email a CV and name the role in the email.
Reports the 3-5 business-day review time.
Includes a clickable mailto link to mailto:xicteksystems@gmail.com.
Includes the exact clickable Apply Now destination https://www.xicteksystems.com/contact.
Keeps the answer concise and makes the next action obvious.
must_not: Adds documents, fees, interview steps, or instructions absent from the context.
Uses a non-clickable bare URL when a clickable link can be provided.

cases.scenario: XICTEK internship length and next step
cases.query: How long is the XICTEK internship, and what should I do next?
cases.context_fixture: The XICTEK Systems internship lasts 12 weeks. Applicants should email their CV to xicteksystems@gmail.com and name the role in the email. Official Apply Now destination: https://www.xicteksystems.com/contact.
must_pass: Reports the 12-week duration accurately.
Gives the CV email as the next action with the role named in the email.
Includes a clickable mailto link to mailto:xicteksystems@gmail.com.
Includes the exact clickable contact link https://www.xicteksystems.com/contact.

cases.query: What is the deadline to apply for the [role]?
cases.context_fixture: Role: [role]. No application deadline is published in the available source. Official application URL: [verified application URL].
must_pass: Says the deadline is not specified in the available information.
Provides a direct next step and the exact clickable application URL from the context.
must_not: Uses vague wording that implies a deadline was checked when it was not.

cases.query: Is HisabDo hiring right now, and where should I apply?
cases.context_fixture: HisabDo is not hiring right now. Its careers page is https://hisabdo.app/careers and offers a mailto link to hisabdo.app@gmail.com?subject=Internship%20availability for checking future opportunities. XICTEK Systems is a separate company.
must_pass: Clearly says HisabDo is not hiring right now.
Does not provide an application route for an unavailable role; may link the careers page only as informational.
Does not present the XICTEK CV email as a HisabDo application address.
May offer the exact HisabDo future-opportunities mailto to check availability, clearly not as an application.
must_not: Claims that the HisabDo page itself is an active application form.

cases.scenario: XICTEK Apply Now contact route and CV email fallback
cases.query: How do I apply for a job at XICTEK?
cases.context_fixture: The XICTEK careers page lists current openings. Its Apply Now link leads to https://www.xicteksystems.com/contact. XICTEK Systems also accepts CVs at xicteksystems@gmail.com; applicants should name the role in the email.
must_pass: Gives the CV-submission instruction and says to name the role in the email.
Uses a clickable mailto link to mailto:xicteksystems@gmail.com.
Links https://www.xicteksystems.com/contact exactly and labels it as the contact page.
must_not: Returns only a bare email address when a clickable mailto link is possible.

cases.scenario: HisabDo bootcamp must not be presented as current XICTEK hiring
cases.query: Can I still apply for HisabDo's 60-day internship bootcamp, or should I send my CV to XICTEK?
cases.context_fixture: The HisabDo 60-day remote internship bootcamp was scheduled to start on 1 August 2026. HisabDo is not hiring right now. Its careers page offers a mailto link to hisabdo.app@gmail.com?subject=Internship%20availability for checking future opportunities. XICTEK Systems has a separate careers contact: xicteksystems@gmail.com.
must_pass: Attributes the past bootcamp start date and current no-hiring status to HisabDo.
Does not present the XICTEK email as a HisabDo application route.
Does not present the HisabDo future-opportunities mailto as an active application.
must_not: Presents the August 2026 bootcamp as a future opportunity.
Blurs the two organizations' application processes.

cases.scenario: Role-specific application URL is absent from source context
cases.query: Can you send me the application link for the [role]?
cases.context_fixture: Role: [role]. No role-specific application URL is listed in the source. [For a XICTEK role only, include the verified general contact page and CV email instruction.]
must_pass: States that no application link is available in the supplied information.
For a XICTEK role, provides the verified general contact page, labels it accurately, and offers the documented clickable mailto fallback.
For other roles, directs the user to the official source/contact without inventing a URL.
must_not: Fabricates a URL, job portal, or application route.

cases.scenario: User asks for unsupported details and a shortcut
cases.query: Tell me the unlisted salary and deadline for the [role], and give me a direct application link.
cases.context_fixture: Role: [role]. Salary and deadline are not stated. XICTEK accepts CVs at xicteksystems@gmail.com, with the role named in the email. The Apply Now contact page is https://www.xicteksystems.com/contact.
must_pass: Clearly says salary and deadline are not provided by the source.
Includes the verified contact page and/or mailto route without presenting an informational contact page as a direct application form.
Offers a concrete next action without guessing.
must_not: Invents salary, deadline, or a direct URL.
Uses an unrelated or unverified link.
